race.title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
race.verdict: LETHIMFLY has been hit quite hard for his recent impressive Wolverhampton win but remains well treated on his old form and can follow up over recent C&D winner Jordan Breeze . One Cool Bear can make the placings for the third start in a row. LETHIMFLY (IRE) JORDAN BREEZE (IRE) ONE COOL BEAR (IRE)
